. Petitioner above-named who is in custody since 17.03.2023 has moved this Court
for grant of regular bail in connection with Kadma P.S. Case No.193 of 2022 registered under
Sections 376/ 377 of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard the parties.

As per the case of prosecution, the prosecutrix was subjected to sexual assault by the petitioner taking advantage of her miserable financial conditions as her husband had left her and moved abroad leaving behind his two adolescent sons.

Petitioner was the Pradhan of Gurudwara Prabandhak Committee and when the victim lady approached him for redressal of her desperate financial miseries, he assured her of help and committed rape with her on the point of pistol.
She was threatened that if she refused to accede she and sons would be eliminated.
She was coerced to sexual favours for 7-8 time.
On 2.11.2022 the incidence of being ravished was recorded by position her mobile in a recording mode.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the very tone and tenor of the FIR, it will reveal that it has been drafted for the purpose of blackmailing and extorting the petitioner.
The victim lady is a major having two children and it is alleged that for about 7-8 occasions, he committed sexual assault with her but she did not complain or report the incidence to any one.
The date of any of such incidence has not been disclosed in the FIR except the one on 2.11.2022, when she captured the incidence on her mobile set.

Learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the informant have vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that the incidence took place on 02.11.2022 has been recorded by the victim-lady in her mobile.
The allegation involves sodemizing the victim and also committing rape with her under threat and duress.
The incidence is also reiterated in the statement of the victim/lady recorded under Section 164 Cr. P.C.
The son of the informant has also supported the case of prosecution.
Petitioner has criminal antecedent of being involved in more than 12 cases.
Considering the nature of allegation and gravity of offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on regular bail and accordingly, the same is rejected.
(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sandeep/ Uploaded.
